headline: Monarch Networth sees up to 56% upside for Grindwell Norton, Carborundum Universal, and Wendt India
hook: China's tax shift fuels Indian abrasive stocks
summary: Chinese abrasive products are losing their tax advantages in global markets, creating a structural tailwind for Indian competitors. Brokerage Monarch Networth Capital has issued bullish forecasts for Grindwell Norton, Carborundum Universal, and Wendt India, projecting up to 56% further upside following a 45% year-to-date rally. Indian retail investors holding specialty manufacturing and industrial chemical stocks should track export volume growth from these players.
why_it_matters: Export demand could accelerate for Indian abrasive manufacturers.
winners_losers: Indian abrasive makers gain / Chinese exporters hurt
